description: ACT Government publishes this point inventory of municipal assets in the Australian Capital Territory. Subtypes include isolation, pressure relief, gate, butterfly, solenoid and check valves, plus hydrants. The provider describes attributes for valve size, lid type and size, material, depth, surface level and make and model. Assets are captured through works-as-executed handover or field audits. Coverage is limited to assets owned or managed by the named ACT government services; private, federal and other directorate assets may be absent. The Socrata catalogue and JSON view metadata are public and free to inspect. Native metadata identifies the licence as CC BY 4.0. Caveats: only metadata was inspected, no dataset rows or geometry values were downloaded. Field definitions do not establish field completeness or current asset condition. For infrastructure simulation, valve locations and types can define control and isolation components; operating settings and hydraulic connectivity need separate evidence. Related catalogue: ACT Government open data portal.
